key_insight: The paper proposes a self-evolving, expert-in-the-loop framework that uses LLM assistance plus expert verification to produce DSM-5-TR-aligned, explainable depression symptom annotations with traceable evidence.
engineering_relevance: It addresses a core bottleneck in mental health AI by improving label quality, auditability, and interpretability for downstream model training and evaluation.
method: Select candidate evidence from text records
Run criterion-level DSM-5-TR analysis and case-level synthesis
Use Example Memory and Reflection Memory to incorporate expert feedback without retraining
evidence_signal: A pilot study on expert-reviewed samples reports improved annotation consistency and explainability while reducing manual revision effort.
watch_item: The framework’s multi-cycle self-improvement is described conceptually, but broader evaluation across repeated feedback cycles and larger datasets is still future work.
paper_title: Self-Evolving Human-Centered Framework for Explainable Depression Symptom Annotation
